meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创作或编辑自定义视频合成作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作多场景视频、品牌短片或自由形式的视频合成
copy.tagline_en: Author or edit custom video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create multi-scene videos, brand reels, or freeform video compositions

howto.what: Claude 会帮你创作或编辑视频项目，包括多场景短片、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。它会先读取项目状态，然后按计划、构建、动画、组装、验证等步骤执行。
howto.when: 当没有更专业的视频工作流适用，或 BRIEF.md 中指定 flow 为 companion 时触发。也适用于较长或多场景的作品。

say.text: 帮我做一个30秒的品牌宣传片，包含三个场景。
修改现有视频项目，把第二个场景的动画换成淡入效果。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create or edit video projects, including multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, and footage remixes. It reads project state and follows a plan-build-animate-assemble-verify workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized video workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Also for longer or multi-scene works.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second brand reel with three scenes.
Edit the existing video project and change the animation in scene 2 to a fade-in.
